page.overview:
What is Watchtower of Thapnen?

The Watchtower of Thapnen is a fictional structure from H. P. Lovecraft's short story "Polaris".

The Watchtower of Thapnen is a tower in the Lomarian city of Olathoë in the Dreamlands. The purpose of the tower is to guard the narrow pass that comes up from behind Mount Noton, providing a defense against potential invaders that would use the pass to launch a surprise attack against Olathoë. In such a case, a signal fire would be lit at the top of the tower to warn the soldiers and thereby save the city from immediate disaster. (: "Polaris")
